source.description: NFL schedule release maintained by Lee Sharpe, published by nflverse

limitations: Score presence plus an age embargo is not independent proof of a final result.
Per-team counts describe accepted source rows, not reconciliation against every scheduled game.
Unknown venues, explicit nonfinal states and conflicting duplicate IDs are excluded.

trainingProtocol.untouchedTest: 2025 games (not used for hyperparameters or calibration)
trainingProtocol.liveRatings: Delayed scored schedule rows through lastGameDate; see trainingInputSafety for unverified finality
trainingProtocol.leakageControl: Chronological pregame ratings, season-to-season mean regression

limitations: Elo-only historical outcome model; no starters, injuries, weather, play-by-play EPA or current lineup updates
Research-only; a 2025 holdout does not establish real-money profitability or a wagering advantage
A season-end rating is not a same-day injury- or roster-aware projection
Team relocation aliases do not resolve all historical franchise and stadium changes
Market outcomes, spreads and totals do not share this moneyline-only model

weekSensitivity.limitation: Within-week resampling only; recurring teams and cross-week dependence remain.

limitations: 2018-2025 historical EPA values are retrospective and may be revised by nflverse
Quarterback / injured-starter status is not verified or modeled
Rest is derived from previous completed team game dates, not itinerary
Future games are excluded from feature history
A holdout Brier improvement does not establish profitable bookmaker execution
Challenger is never automatically promoted based solely on a positive point estimate
Score presence plus an age embargo is not independent proof of a final result.
Per-team counts describe accepted source rows, not reconciliation against every scheduled game.
Unknown venues, explicit nonfinal states and conflicting duplicate IDs are excluded.
